constraints: Options apply only to the next SOAP request sent via WEB SERVICE CALL; call this command once per option to set, in any order. If the same option is set multiple times before the call, only the last value is used.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): Web Services (Client) SOAP call sequence: WEB SERVICE AUTHENTICATE (optional) and/or WEB SERVICE SET OPTION (optional) configure per-call client state -> WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER is called once per request parameter to build the SOAP message -> WEB SERVICE CALL sends the request (consuming the authenticate/option/parameter state and erasing any previous result) -> WEB SERVICE GET RESULT retrieves each returned value (pass '*' on the final call to free memory) -> on error, WEB SERVICE Get info can be called from an ON ERR CALL method to inspect the SOAP fault.

overloadMerges.note: Restored sentinelValues on option from the 6 documented 'Web Service ...' option constants; autoparse leaves option as a plain Integer and value as an untyped Integer/Text union with no per-option mapping.

params.name: option
params.description: Code of the option to set

sentinelValues.meaning: Web Service display auth dialog: value is 0 (never display, default) or 1 (display the authentication dialog box, only shown if the service requires authentication)
Web Service HTTP compression: value is the Web Service Compression constant; enables gzip/deflate compression of the next SOAP request (client and server 4D v11.3+ only)
Web Service HTTP timeout: value is the client-side wait timeout in seconds (180 by default)
Web Service reset auth settings: value is 0 (keep authentication info for the session) or 1 (erase it after each WEB SERVICE CALL, the default)
Web Service SOAP header: value is an XML root element reference to insert as a header in the SOAP request
Web Service SOAP version: value is the Web Service SOAP_1_1 or Web Service SOAP_1_2 constant

params.name: value
params.description: New value of the option; its meaning and type depend on which option is passed (see option's sentinelValues)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets, for the next SOAP request triggered by WEB SERVICE CALL, the option identified by option to value.
